description: This file defines the FencedCodeRenderer class, which handles rendering of fenced code blocks within Markdown content. It supports syntax highlighting via the Highlight\Highlighter and special rendering for 'tex' and 'mermaid' code blocks.

classes.name: FencedCodeRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for processing fenced code blocks in Markdown, supporting syntax highlighting and special content types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with a new Highlighter instance.

methods.name: pre
methods.description:
Wraps content inside

HTML elements, applying optional attributes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method to render a fenced code block node, handling special cases for 'tex' and 'mermaid', or default code highlighting.

methods.name: renderCode
methods.description: Performs syntax highlighting if a language is specified, otherwise escapes content, and wraps it in a preformatted block.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Extracts the language identifier from info words; returns false if none present.
